test max-delete-track-renames
# - Set up with 9 files.
# - Rename 5 files on Path1, exceeding the default max-delete threshold.
# - Confirm --track-renames alone retains the existing safety abort.
# - Confirm the opt-in rename-aware check permits the tracked renames.

test initial bisync
bisync resync

test rename-aware max-delete requires track-renames
bisync max-delete-renames-aware
copy-listings requires-track-fail

test rename-aware max-delete rejects invalid track-renames strategies early
bisync track-renames max-delete-renames-aware track-renames-strategy=banana
copy-listings invalid-strategy-fail

test rename-aware hash matching rejects ignored listing checksums
bisync track-renames max-delete-renames-aware ignore-listing-checksum
copy-listings ignore-hash-fail

test force bypasses the rename-aware preflight setup
bisync track-renames max-delete-renames-aware force

test rename >50% of Path1 files
copy-as {path1/}file1.txt {path1/}renamed/ file1.txt
delete-file {path1/}file1.txt
copy-as {path1/}file2.txt {path1/}renamed/ file2.txt
delete-file {path1/}file2.txt
copy-as {path1/}file3.txt {path1/}renamed/ file3.txt
delete-file {path1/}file3.txt
copy-as {path1/}file4.txt {path1/}renamed/ file4.txt
delete-file {path1/}file4.txt
copy-as {path1/}file5.txt {path1/}renamed/ file5.txt
delete-file {path1/}file5.txt

test track-renames alone should retain the max-delete safety abort
bisync track-renames
copy-listings initial-fail

test rename-aware max-delete should permit tracked renames
bisync track-renames max-delete-renames-aware checkers=1 transfers=1

test rename-aware max-delete should work from Path2
copy-as {path2/}renamed/file1.txt {path2/}renamed2/ file1.txt
delete-file {path2/}renamed/file1.txt
copy-as {path2/}renamed/file2.txt {path2/}renamed2/ file2.txt
delete-file {path2/}renamed/file2.txt
copy-as {path2/}renamed/file3.txt {path2/}renamed2/ file3.txt
delete-file {path2/}renamed/file3.txt
copy-as {path2/}renamed/file4.txt {path2/}renamed2/ file4.txt
delete-file {path2/}renamed/file4.txt
copy-as {path2/}renamed/file5.txt {path2/}renamed2/ file5.txt
delete-file {path2/}renamed/file5.txt
bisync track-renames max-delete-renames-aware checkers=1 transfers=1

test unmatched deletes should still exceed max-delete
copy-as {path1/}renamed2/file1.txt {path1/}moved/ file1.txt
delete-file {path1/}renamed2/file1.txt
delete-file {path1/}renamed2/file2.txt
delete-file {path1/}renamed2/file3.txt
delete-file {path1/}renamed2/file4.txt
delete-file {path1/}renamed2/file5.txt
delete-file {path1/}file6.txt
delete-file {path1/}file7.txt
bisync track-renames max-delete-renames-aware checkers=1 transfers=1
copy-listings partial-fail
